ageGateQuestion: Are you 18 years old or older?
ageGateSubtitle: My Care is for adults only.
ageGateBlocked: My Care is currently available to adult users only.
whyDoWeAskBody: Your barangay helps your Rural Health Unit see health trends in your area. Only anonymous, area-level counts are ever shared — never your individual answers.
checkSymptomsSubtitle: Describe how you feel and we'll guide you.
notADiagnosisLong: This is not a diagnosis. For guidance only.
voiceUnavailable: Voice input isn't available offline yet. Type your symptoms or tap one below.
clarificationBanner: A few more questions to ensure the right guidance.
notADiagnosisResult: This is not a diagnosis. Consult a doctor for recurring or worrying symptoms.
resultHomeBody: Based on your symptoms, you can manage this at home. Rest and drink plenty of fluids.
resultRhuTitle: Go to the nearest Rural Health Unit.
resultRhuBody: You need to visit the Rural Health Unit within 24 hours. Show this screen to a health worker.
resultEmergencyBody: Your symptoms may be serious. Go to a hospital immediately or call your barangay emergency hotline.
showToHealthWorker: Show this screen to your health worker.
healthTipsComingSoon: Tips for this result are coming soon.
tipRhu1: Visit the RHU within 24 hours for proper assessment.
tipRhu2: Drink plenty of water and get adequate rest.
tipRhu3: Monitor your fever. If it worsens, go to the hospital immediately.
tipRhu4: Do not take medications without a doctor's prescription.
aboutMyCareBody: My Care is an offline-first health triage app built for geographically isolated areas. No account, no login, and no personal data collected — the triage rules run entirely on your device.
helpDocumentationBody: This is a capstone project in active development. For questions, reach the development team through your barangay health worker.
startOverConfirm: This clears your language, barangay, and saved sessions from this device. Continue?
